description: Install Arcade in Claude Desktop, Cowork, Claude Code, and Codex.

plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English — email, calendar, issues, chat — and Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser — without ever handing your agent a key. In Claude Code and Copilot CLI it also sends usage events with no lasting ID (no prompt text or app data); set ARCADE_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0 to turn them off.
